title: Complete quadratic bit
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x=(x_1,\\ldots,x_n)\\in\\mathbb F_2^n$. The complete quadratic bit of $x$ is $\\sum_{1\\le i<j\\le n}x_i x_j$ in $\\mathbb F_2$.
